reasoning_trace.value: The paper discusses the concept of interaction-tolerant (IT) soliton signals for dual-polarization transmission in nonlinear frequency division multiplexing (NFDM) systems. The authors propose a pre-distortion scheme to mitigate the collision distortion on the soliton quantities, which is determined by the polarization angle and polarization differential phase of two solitons.
